name: Shealtiel
overview: Shealtiel is a male descendant from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah. His lineage situates him within the royal line of Judah, highlighting his place in the biblical genealogies. No additional personal notes are provided beyond his tribal affiliation and paternal relationship.
namesAndTitles: The name Shealtiel means 'I have asked [him] of God [El],' with possible interpretations including 'God [El] is a shield' or 'God [El] is a victor.' This reflects a meaningful connection to God, emphasizing reliance on divine help or protection. The name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 3:17.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shealtiel as the son of Jehoiachin, also known as Jeconiah. Beyond this paternal connection, no other family relationships are detailed in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Shealtiel's significance in the biblical narrative arises from his role as a link in the royal lineage of Judah, being the son of Jehoiachin. This connection places him within the messianic line that ultimately leads to Christ, underscoring God's providential preservation of His covenant people through successive generations. His presence in the genealogies affirms the continuity of God's promises despite the challenges faced by the Davidic line.
